sprint.name: Sprint 3: Agentic QA & Governance
sprint.goal: Integrating autonomous auditing fleet, security hardening, and live governance orchestration.

tasks.summary: LATAM Entry: Locale Selection & GTM Sizing (es-419 vs pt-BR)
tasks.description: Evaluate market opportunity, localization complexity, and commercial ROI between Latin American Spanish (es-419) and Brazilian Portuguese (pt-BR).

tasks.summary: LATAM Entry: Legal & Data Privacy Compliance Review
tasks.description: Audit regulatory requirements and regional consumer data privacy laws across target Latin American jurisdictions.

tasks.summary: APAC Vision: Executive Market Scope & Localization Strategy
tasks.description: Define business vision, enterprise partnership model, and executive engagement strategy for Asia-Pacific technology hubs (Taipei, Tokyo, Singapore).

tasks.summary: APAC Vision: CJK Rendering & Font Stack Engineering
tasks.description: Validate typography, font loading performance, and bidirectional/multilingual UI rendering for Traditional Chinese and Japanese storefronts.

tasks.summary: Annotation Mode UX with Smart Navigation

tasks.summary: Multimodal Bento Box Experiences & STAR Frameworks

Architect a robust backend proxy layer for external service integrations with rate limiting and API key verification.

tasks.summary: Governance Dashboard: Pre-Approval Queue & Merge Gates
tasks.description: Deploy automated governance approval workflows and audit trails for production release gates.

tasks.summary: Resolve LQA pt-PT Legal Term Mapping & Imprint
tasks.description: Standardize European Portuguese terminology for statutory disclosures and verify compliant Imprint page.

tasks.summary: GDPR Compliance Audit for EU Expansion
tasks.description: Conduct thorough GDPR and ePrivacy directive compliance assessment for European market readiness.

tasks.summary: Linguistic Overhaul & Legal AI Agent Disclaimers

Enforce strict HTTPS redirect, HSTS headers, and SSL certificate installation on host.
